regression.scope: All prior community refinements including Azazel repeated same-source curse reversal, Conan all six slots, sleep/stealth/resources, movement/collision, held gates, aim priority, digest and purity.

transportAndView.scope: Real snapshot and Colyseus encode/decode, client registry visibility/lifecycle, Forge replay and client prediction hold. NullEngine geometry is not rendered visual acceptance.

mutationImprovement: The original range test only checked eventual stop, so removing the range guard escaped detection. The corrected test asserts next-tick stop and unchanged position; the same mutation now fails. Sources restored after each probe.
semantics: Source-owned E has acceleration, braking, sharp turn speed reduction and visible phases; root/stun/slow and cast/aim facing priority remain effective. Expiry removes only its own drive grant.

EX catches the first visible legal enemy or real blocking terrain along its direction. Enemy branch pulls the enemy toward the caster; terrain branch pulls self. Empty space is not an anchor, immune first targets block the catch, and ordinary allies are not pulled.
A grapple has a finite total travel budget. Range, collision, death, hidden target, zone change and settled duel terminate it. No airborne throw or damage is added.
Live snapshot and Forge replay share procedural board/tether rendering. Preview movement orders and test wall are session-only actual SimWorld inputs, never changes to the hero project.
Navigation, moving ability collision and final collision cleanup now use the same active gate geometry; a held-open gate does not become solid again in the cleanup or slide pass.
initialFailures: PullVariant initially lacked the grapple type; corrected before passing typechecks.
Single-target effect rejects an unused side field; recipe uses the existing single-target contract.
A held-open gate still blocked the rider during the existing collision cleanup; shared worldObstacles fixes navigation, forced movement, slide and cleanup consistently.
knownLimits: Procedural deck/wheels and tether are gameplay markers, not original skateboard/belt model or animation acceptance. Dedicated football, needle/watch, art and sound remain pending.
Full original-design acceptance, rendered visual acceptance, current-service ZIP and formal publication remain incomplete.
